blocks.rationale: The installed library is empty, so no valid lift or revision is possible. This joint creation package adds two grounded terminal helpers: one evaluates the cited termination-payment subparagraph without importing its sibling condition, and one deterministically aggregates aligned per-bag fees under the source’s higher-of-oversize-or-overweight rule. Together they target all three failed parents.

inputs.name: subparagraph_applies
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the payment was made upon or after termination of employment because of death or retirement for disability, as specified by the cited subparagraph?

skill.intent: Classify an affirmative claim that a payment satisfies the termination-cause condition in §3306(b)(10)(A), independently of the separate plan condition in subparagraph (B).

outputs.description: The native binary classification label: Entailment or Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: subparagraph_applies
fields.question: Was the current payment made upon or after termination because of death or retirement for disability?

reads.question: Evaluate the current payment, termination event, and stated reason against only the condition expressed in the cited termination-cause subparagraph.

origin.quote: upon or after the termination of an employee's employment relationship because of (i) death, or (ii) retirement for disability

source_obligations.statement: Check whether the current payment followed termination of the employment relationship and whether death or retirement for disability caused that termination.

source_provenance.quote: (A) upon or after the termination of an employee's employment relationship because of (i) death, or (ii) retirement for disability

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What is the integer ticket price stated in the current facts?

inputs.name: base_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in fact order, what checked-bag base fee applies after carry-on, cabin, route, bag-position, and complimentary-bag rules, using zero when no base fee applies?

inputs.name: oversize_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, what oversize fee applies under the current route and total outside dimensions, using zero when none applies?

inputs.name: overweight_fees
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, what overweight fee applies under the current route, cabin, complimentary or excess status, and weight, using zero when none applies?

skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket-plus-bag total from aligned current-bag base, oversize, and overweight fee arrays, charging the higher size-or-weight surcharge for each bag.

outputs.description: The exact integer ticket price plus all applicable current-bag base fees and higher-of-size-or-weight surcharges.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

fields.name: base_fees
fields.question: What aligned integer base-fee array results for all current items after applying allowance and checked-bag-position rules?

fields.name: oversize_fees
fields.question: What aligned integer oversize-fee array results for all current items from their total outside dimensions and route?

fields.name: overweight_fees
fields.question: What aligned integer overweight-fee array results for all current items from their weights, route, cabin, and complimentary or excess status?

reads.question: Resolve the current itinerary and every listed item against the source’s carry-on, checked-bag, complimentary-bag, size, weight, route, cabin, and bag-position rules.
reads.source_locator: current source facts, question, and bag-fee rules

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Classify every current item under the carry-on and checked-bag rules, then select any applicable base fee by route, cabin, complimentary status, and checked-bag position.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Determine aligned oversize and overweight fees for each current item from its dimensions and weight.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: For every bag, add its checked-bag base fee and only the higher of its applicable oversize and overweight fees, then add all bag charges to the ticket price.

source_provenance.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.
The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.
